alex.cust: Hey team — after our tenant alias flip this morning, our rerank calls to /v1/rerank return 404 for model_id 'revise-ranker-2022'. Worked before. Any deprecations?

jess_support: Hmm, 404 usually means the model id the client resolved doesn't exist. Can you paste the request (no api key) and the model_id you sent?

alex.cust: sure — this is what our client sends:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>"
 -H "Content-Type: application/json"
 -d '{"model":"revise-ranker-2022","queries":["q1","q2"],"documents":["doc A","doc B"]}'
```
We switched tenant alias from 'acme-prod' -> 'acme-main' around 03:00 UTC. SDK should resolve alias to the active model.

jess_support: Thanks. Can you also share the x-tenant header or any alias param the client sends? Some SDKs cache resolved model ids locally.

alex.cust: client sends header `X-Tenant: acme-main`. We did a quick restart of the service but still 404.

devon_sre: I pulled logs for their token; I'm seeing lookup attempts to model id `revise-ranker-2022@acme-prod` — interesting, the alias resolution looks stale on the client side. Server responded with 404 from model registry lookup.

marco_eng: Sometimes when alias->model mapping changed during a rollout, client caches the numeric model id and keeps calling the retired id. SDK v1.3.0 had a bug where cached id isn't refreshed on 404. Which SDK version?

alex.cust: We shipped SDK 1.3.0 in our infra image. Oof.

jess_support: Ok, repro steps for support: 1) call /v1/models/resolve with alias `acme-main` and compare response to what the client is using. 2) if client is calling a retired id, clear the SDK cache or upgrade to SDK 1.3.2+ which retries alias resolve on 404.

devon_sre: I ran resolve for them: server returns `revise-ranker-2024` (new id). Client kept calling `revise-ranker-2022`. That matches the 404.

alex.cust: Workaround for now? We can patch quickly.

marco_eng: Two options: A) Restart your service to clear in-memory SDK cache (quick). B) Add an explicit alias-resolve call at startup: `GET /v1/models/resolve?alias=acme-main` and store returned id. C) Better: upgrade SDK to 1.3.2 which auto-refreshes on 404.

jess_support: Also note: if you see unexpected zero scores or empty rerank results in other tenants, don't assume it's the same root cause — that can be input-shape mismatch. For this thread it's an id mismatch -> 404.

alex.cust: Restart fixed it. Thx team :thumbsup: — we will schedule an SDK upgrade.

devon_sre: I'll add an internal follow-up ticket for us to add a server-side 404 hint to suggest alias refresh when model id retired. Filing INF-9123.

deploy-bot: deploy rollback detected for alias-mapping-service at 2024-10-12T03:15:00Z — previous mapping restored temporarily.

marco_eng: Filing a small SDK patch to explicitly refresh on 404 and emit a metric so we can catch this during rollouts.

alex.cust: appreciate it. closing the loop here.

jess_support: Thanks — marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
